ISP overrides for the OV5647 NoIR module (no infrared cut filter) on
L4T R32 and R35, for daylight. The same LED sources as
camera_overrides_noir.isp plus a daylight white measured in shade,
with the lux prior of the white balance off and the sensor black
level subtracted. Checked outdoors on a Nano (R32) and a Xavier NX
(R35). Generated by tools/isp/make-override.py from
camera_overrides_noir_daylight.json. See docs/isp-tuning.md.
Daylight only. The black level is right at low gain. In dim light the
sensor black falls, and this file crushes the shadows. Indoors it does
worse than camera_overrides_noir.isp. Outdoors, saturation=1.5 on
nvarguscamerasrc brings back some of the colour the infrared takes.
Install:
sudo cp camera_overrides_noir_daylight.isp /var/nvidia/nvcam/settings/camera_overrides.isp
sudo chmod 664 /var/nvidia/nvcam/settings/camera_overrides.isp
sudo rm -f /var/nvidia/nvcam/settings/nvcam_cache_*.bin
sudo systemctl restart nvargus-daemon
A line Argus rejects stops the camera, and journalctl -u nvargus-daemon
names it.
